description.text:
The Family Pokémon Trading Card Game set (宝可梦卡牌 家庭组合) came out on 17 November 2023 for families learning the game together. It held three ready-built 60-card decks, led by Cinderace V, Pikachu V and Tyranitar V, with a coin, damage counters, a play mat, two rule guides, one written for parents and one for children, a beginner's guide and storage boxes, so a family could start playing straight away. On Pokémon's Tmall store only members could buy it.

Its cards are numbered out of 53, with six basic Energy cards unnumbered. Each card carries a small silhouette of a deck's lead Pokémon in its bottom right corner, marking the deck it belongs to: the Cinderace V deck plays Grass and Fire Pokémon with Appletun V, the Pikachu V deck Water and Lightning Pokémon with Greninja V, and the Tyranitar V deck Fighting and Darkness Pokémon with Lucario V.
